==About==

A {{i|Sweet Bambi}} must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. Sweet Bambi is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Mushrooms}} Food Group.
